rules.description: Applicant must be a limited company registered at Companies House
rules.reason_if_failed: Only limited companies registered at Companies House must register for Corporation Tax. Sole traders and partnerships use Self Assessment instead.

rules.description: Company must have a valid Companies House registration number
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be registered at Companies House before registering for Corporation Tax

rules.description: Must register within 3 months of starting to trade or before first accounting period ends
rules.reason_if_failed: You should have registered within 3 months of starting to trade. Late registration may result in penalties.

rules.description: Company must be UK-based or trading in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: Corporation Tax only applies to UK companies or non-UK companies trading through a UK permanent establishment

edge_cases.description: Company is dormant (not trading and no significant accounting transactions)
edge_cases.action: Dormant companies may not need to register immediately. You must register when you start trading. Contact HMRC for guidance.

edge_cases.description: Company is part of a corporate group with existing HMRC relationship
edge_cases.action: Group companies have special registration requirements. Route to HMRC group registration team.

edge_cases.description: Non-UK company with UK permanent establishment
edge_cases.action: Non-resident companies have different registration requirements. Route to HMRC International team.

edge_cases.description: Company already has a Corporation Tax UTR
edge_cases.action: Company is already registered. Use existing UTR for filing returns. No need to re-register.
